summary: Frontend E2E test of AI Assignment Maker (/ops/ai-assignment). Found and fixed a CRITICAL bug: AdminAIAssignment component was referenced in App.js route but never imported, causing 'AdminAIAssignment is not defined' ReferenceError and full page crash. After fix, entire flow works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: AdminAIAssignment used in <Route> but not imported -> ReferenceError, page crash on /ops/ai-assignment

action_items: None — the missing import was added by testing agent. Main agent should verify the change in /app/frontend/src/App.js line ~55 and keep it.
critical_code_review_comments: App.js imports for admin pages are numerous and easy to miss — consider centralised barrel export or route registry to prevent this class of bug.
AdminAIAssignment.jsx: no client-side max-length on textarea; consider guard against extreme text sizes before hitting LLM endpoint.
Blast dialog auto-opens when done step is shown; if user closes it and clicks 'Blast it' button, works. Fine.
generate() sends multipart even when only text — acceptable but text-only could be JSON for smaller payload.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 assignment titled 'TEST_AI Dental Custom' (cleaning, Downtown · 21202, $22/hr, 3 slots, Fri Jul 10 09:00). Was NOT blasted (Not now clicked).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AI Assignment Maker frontend is verified end-to-end. Fixed missing import in App.js. All flow steps passed: navigation renders page, empty-submit shows toast 'Type some details or upload a document', GPT-5.5 parse returned draft with all fields prefilled correctly (title/description/category=cleaning/location/address/datetime/pay=22/slots=3/duration=5/phone), title-edit + Create -> done step + blast dialog opens, 'Not now' closes it, 'Create another' returns to empty input step, and the custom-titled assignment appears in /ops/assignments. File upload path was NOT exercised (per request), but backend already verified.
rca of the issue: AdminAIAssignment.jsx exists and exports default. AdminLayout.jsx has the sidebar link. App.js line 147 has <Route path='ai-assignment' element={<AdminAIAssignment />} /> but the corresponding `import AdminAIAssignment from '@/pages/admin/AdminAIAssignment'` line was never added. Result: JSX transpiles OK but at render time the identifier is undefined -> ReferenceError shown as red overlay, blocking the entire route. Fix: added import statement adjacent to other admin imports.
